director_comp.notes: [chunk 1/1] NVDA DEF 14A Director Compensation section (filed 2024-05-14): This section contains routine director and executive compensation disclosures, related-party transaction disclosures, and beneficial ownership tables. No SIFI-material entities, hidden leverage, circularity, capex commitments, counterparty concentration, or risk signals are present. Key findings: (1) Director compensation is standard (~$340k annually, paid in cash retainer + RSUs). (2) No capex commitments, strategic partnerships, or material customer/supplier relationships disclosed. (3) Related-party transactions involve only family members of CEO Jen-Hsun Huang and director Aarti Shah employed by NVIDIA; compensation is determined under standard NVIDIA practices (~$370k, $330k, $450k respectively). (4) Beneficial ownership table shows Huang owns 3.79% of shares (93.5M), with holdings in family trusts and the Huang Foundation; largest institutional holders are Vanguard (8.30%), BlackRock (7.33%), and FMR LLC (5.19%). (5) No mention of investments in AI labs, off-balance-sheet SPVs, capex commitments to counterparties, or SIFI-relevant risks. Conclusion: This proxy section is purely governance/compensation disclosure. No extraction warranted under SIFI materiality standards.
